correctness.rationale: Fink's formula makes pristineness equivalent to q^7=F_7(c). Exact algebra gives 5040 F_7(c)=(c+8)G(c) and G(-8)=-2^14*3^2, so gcd(c+8,G(c)) has no prime factor >=5 except none. For q>=11 the full q^7 must lie in one factor; the size inequality c<4q prevents it from lying in c+8, forcing c<=5032. For q=3,5,7 the same size inequality gives c<28. Exact enumeration of c=1..5032 finds no seventh power.
